citation: National Weather Service Chicago. 'The 150th Anniversary of the Great Chicago Fire of 1871'. 8 October 2021.
author: National Weather Service, Chicago office
locator: 'Weather Prior to the Fire' (the months and the week before) and 'Weather During the Fire: October 8th'.
rights_note: A work of the United States government; public domain.
note: A reconstruction from surviving volunteer and Army observations: Chicago's own station records were lost in the fire. Its regional highs and winds are estimates, not a measured street-level reading in the city.
what_it_supplies: 3.55 inches of rain from 7 July to 8 October; no rain at all from 29 September to 8 October
highs in the low to mid 80s on 8 October; southwest winds estimated to peak at about 35-45 mph
what_it_does_not_supply: the temperature or wind at any hour on any Chicago street
